description: Harpocrates is archived and unsupported (see README.md). Renovate is disabled: the repo takes no further dependency updates, and its scheduled pipeline no longer runs because CI is turned off in .gitlab-ci.yml. `enabled: false` is a second, independent stop so the repo is still skipped if it is ever picked up by a Renovate run driven from outside this project. The previous config (grouping and automerge rules for the svelte, RustCrypto, cargo, and npm ecosystems) is preserved in git history at the parent of the commit that archived the project.
